source.quote: $500 per item and a maximum of $50,000 per Account

verification.note: No per-claim cap in the guide. Notice 90 days and documents 120 days from the loss, each 'or as soon as reasonably possible'. Police report may be required within 48 hours. Rewards-paid purchases also qualify. The guide covers refurbished items accompanied by a warranty; conditionsAllowed is ['new'] only because v1 models new items. Needs a human review per SPEC §7.3. excludedCategories is Paywise's reading of the exclusions, not Chase's category list: dining and grocery (perishables, consumables), pharmacy (consumables, medical equipment), travel (tickets), gift_card (cash and cards), services (not an item). Apparel, home and general items aren't excluded. Basis: "Coverage is secondary and in excess of valid and collectible insurance" (benefits-verification.md §4.3).
